tools.name: check_webmcp
tools.description: Answer one question about a public website: does it expose WebMCP (document.modelContext) tools to AI agents? Returns webmcp_detected and detection_status (what AG AgentReady knows: runtime_validated, static_signal_detected, no_webmcp_detected, runtime_validation_unavailable or check_failed) separately from live_check_status (this attempt only: completed, site_access_denied, bot_protection_detected, dns_resolution_failed, validator_network_failure, redirect_safety_block, navigation_timeout, browser_unavailable, runtime_validation_unavailable or check_failed). If a live attempt cannot complete for a previously runtime-verified site, the last verified tool count and tools are returned, labelled last_verified with last_verified_at and the verified page URL, plus a neutral warning.

website_url.description: Public website address to check for WebMCP support

tools.name: get_directory_listing
tools.description: Read one public AG AgentReady WebMCP directory profile by its site key (the domain), including its published capability description and the public list of WebMCP tools that site exposes.

site_key.description: Directory site key (the domain), e.g. example.com

tools.name: get_scan_report
tools.description: Read an existing AG AgentReady report using the public report token from a report link (/report/<token>). Read-only — it never starts a scan. Returns the free public snapshot only; paid or locked findings and private data are never returned.

report_token.description: Public report token from a report URL, e.g. /report/<token> (48 hex characters)

tools.name: run_website_scan
tools.description: Run an AG AgentReady readiness scan on ONE public website and return its free public snapshot: overall, WebMCP/agent, revenue and trust scores, an executive summary, the WebMCP detection block, the visible findings and the public report link. In-page WebMCP tool. If the scan is still running after about a minute it returns status "processing" plus the report URL — that is not a failure.

website_url.description: Public website address to analyse, for example https://example.com

tools.name: search_webmcp_directory
tools.description: Search AG AgentReady's public WebMCP directory of websites that expose agent-callable capability. Supports free-text search, category, verification tier, sort order and pagination. Returns public capability information only — no scores, findings or owner data.

search.description: Optional free-text query (domain or display name)
